tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.rimerite.sword: Chills targets and puts out fire; +3 damage to fire-immune mobs
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.rimerite.axe: Chills targets and puts out fire; +3 damage to fire-immune mobs
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.rimerite.pickaxe: Magma blocks drop obsidian and ice drops itself (no magma change with Silk Touch)
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.rimerite.shovel: Sand may give snowballs; snow layers give an extra one (not with Silk Touch)
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.rimerite.hoe: Leaves and grass may give a snowball (not with Silk Touch)
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.rimerite.armor: Full set: chills melee attackers. Each piece: no freezing in powder snow
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.rimerite.repair: Repair: Frostery input slot with cold fuel; each repair uses up that fuel (output slot empty or nuggets)
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.cindrite.axe: Sets targets on fire; drops may come out smelted
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.cindrite.pickaxe: Ores may drop smelted; coal ore, basalt and tuff may give a fire charge (not with Silk Touch)
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.cindrite.shovel: Drops may come out smelted (not with Silk Touch)
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.cindrite.hoe: Drops may come out smelted (not with Silk Touch)
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.cindrite.armor: Full set: no fire or lava damage, flames go out on leaving; burning slowly wears it
tooltip.ohnomoremeteors.cindrite.repair: Repair: furnace input slot with heat fuel; each repair uses up that fuel (output slot empty or nuggets)
